# Language Learning Model Summary File (llms.txt)
# Created for large language model consumption

## dotPH
> dotPH is the official registry for the .PH country-code top-level domain (ccTLD), offering domain registration, secure hosting, productivity suites like Google Workspace and Microsoft 365, and other value-added services tailored for Philippine businesses and individuals.

---

## Core Services & Products

- [Home](https://www.dot.ph/): Explore domains, hosting, email, SSL, and other digital tools.

- [Whois Lookup](https://www.dot.ph/whois/): Perform real-time WHOIS queries; where you can check if the domain is available or already registered. If it's registered, user can also see the registrant details of the domain (if the domain has no Private Registration).
- [Private Registration (WHOIS Privacy)](https://www.dot.ph/private-registration/): Hide registrant details of the domain in WHOIS search results; USD 10.00/year.
- [Registry Lock](https://www.dot.ph/registry-lock/): Adds multi-step verification to protect domains from unauthorized changes; USD 100.00/year.

---

### Social Media Domain

- [Social Media Domains](https://www.dot.ph/social-media-domains): A special type of .PH domain from dotPH that allows you to create custom subdomain redirects (e.g., `fb.socmedbrand.ph`, `zoom.socmedbrand.ph`) pointing to your social media and online profiles. This lets brands and individuals unify their presence across platforms with short, branded URLs. Supported redirection options include Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, LinkedIn, YouTube, Google Docs, Google Drive, Dropbox, Zoom, Lazada, and Shopee. No hosting required. Ideal for consolidating and promoting your digital presence using a memorable .PH domain.

  **Pricing**: USD 10.00/year
  **Use Case**: Perfect for content creators, marketers, and brands who want a unified link for their social media profiles, promotions, and campaigns using a verified PH-based identity.

---

### SSL Certificates

- [Secure Socket Layer (SSL)](https://www.dot.ph/ssl): A value-added service (VAS) offered by dotPH that provides encryption and security for websites using a .PH domain. SSL helps protect user data, builds trust with visitors, and is essential for any site handling forms, logins, or transactions.

  - *Domain Validation (DV)*: USD 19.95/year  
    Validates domain ownership and activates the padlock icon in browsers. Includes a trust seal and $50,000 warranty.  
    **Use Case**: Ideal for personal websites, blogs, and small businesses needing basic site encryption.

  - *Organization Validation (OV)*: USD 115.00/year  
    Verifies your company's identity and displays additional business info in the certificate.  
    **Use Case**: Recommended for businesses, NGOs, or government-related sites that require stronger trust signals.

  - *Wildcard SSL*: USD 299.95/year  
    Secures your primary domain and all its subdomains under a single certificate.  
    **Use Case**: Perfect for businesses managing multiple services like blog.domain.ph, store.domain.ph, etc.

---

### Hosting Plans (cPanel)

- [Shared Linux Hosting](https://www.dot.ph/shared-linux-hosting): A value-added service (VAS) by dotPH that offers cPanel-powered web hosting for .PH domain owners, freelancers, small businesses, agencies, and developers. Plans are optimized for speed, control, and ease of use.

#### Single-Domain Hosting

- [Single-Domain Hosting](https://www.dot.ph/single-domain-hosting/): Designed for individuals or businesses managing a single website - ideal for personal blogs, portfolios, or online shops.

  - *Starter*: USD 6.50/month  
    30GB storage, 100GB bandwidth, 10 subdomains, 50 email accounts.  
    **Use Case**: Perfect for basic websites, landing pages, or online resumes.

  - *Professional*: USD 15.00/month  
    60GB storage, 200GB bandwidth, 15 subdomains, 100 email accounts.  
    **Use Case**: Suited for freelancers, bloggers, or business owners looking for better performance.

  - *Deluxe*: USD 35.00/month  
    120GB storage, 500GB bandwidth, free SSL, 25 subdomains, 300 email accounts.  
    **Use Case**: Ideal for eCommerce stores or growing businesses with higher traffic and email needs.

#### Multiple-Domain Hosting

- [Multiple-Domain Hosting](https://www.dot.ph/multiple-domain-hosting/): For users managing several websites - such as developers, digital agencies, or businesses with multiple brands. Most plans include free SSL and email allocations.

  - *MD1*: USD 22.00/month  
    10 domains, 40GB storage, 200 emails.  
    **Use Case**: Ideal for freelancers handling client sites or side projects.

  - *MD2*: USD 41.80/month  
    20 domains, 60GB storage, 400 emails.  
    **Use Case**: Suited for small agencies or developers hosting multiple clients.

  - *MD3*: USD 65.00/month  
    40 domains, 100GB storage, 500 emails, free SSL.  
    **Use Case**: Great for growing teams or agencies scaling their hosting services.

  - *MD4*: USD 75.00/month  
    50 domains, 120GB storage, 600 emails, free SSL.  
    **Use Case**: For businesses managing multiple brands or high-traffic campaigns.

  - *MD5*: USD 85.00/month  
    60 domains, 150GB storage, 800 emails, free SSL.  
    **Use Case**: Built for hosting resellers or enterprise setups managing a large volume of websites.

---

### WooCommerce Store Hosting

- [WooCommerce Hosting](https://www.dot.ph/woocommerce/): A value-added service (VAS) by dotPH for .PH domain owners and Filipino entrepreneurs or anyone targeting the Philippine market who want to launch an online store. This hosting plan supports **WordPress websites that use the WooCommerce plugin**, offering a fully managed eCommerce hosting environment.  
  *Note: A working WordPress site is required and not included in this plan.*

  - *Start-up*: USD 2.50/month (50% off first year; renews at USD 60.00/year)  
    25GB storage, 1 store, 1 free 10GB email.  
    **Use Case**: Ideal for home-based sellers, solo entrepreneurs, or anyone launching their first online store on a budget.

  - *Pro*: USD 4.00/month (50% off first year; renews at USD 96.00/year)  
    50GB storage, 1 store, 1 free 10GB emai accountl.  
    **Use Case**: Best for growing online shops that need more space for products, images, and customer transactions.

---

### Productivity Suites

- [Microsoft 365 Business Email](https://www.dot.ph/microsoft-365/): A value-added service (VAS) by dotPH that provides licensed Microsoft tools for productivity, communication, and professional email. Designed for individuals and organizations using a .PH domain - whether based in the Philippines or targeting the PH market.

  - *Business Basic*: USD 72.00/user/year  
    Includes Exchange (business email), Microsoft Teams, OneDrive (1TB), and web/mobile versions of Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.  
    **Use Case**: Ideal for startups, remote teams, or entrepreneurs needing professional email and collaboration tools without desktop apps.  
    *(Formerly Office 365 Business Essentials)*

  - *Business Standard*: USD 150.00/user/year  
    All features of Business Basic, plus desktop versions of Office apps (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook), and extra tools like Publisher (PC only) and Bookings.  
    **Use Case**: Great for growing businesses or distributed teams that need full-featured Office software across devices.  
    *(Formerly Office 365 Business Premium)*

  - *Apps for Business*: USD 99.00/user/year  
    Desktop versions of Office apps only (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook), plus OneDrive. Does not include business email or Teams.  
    **Use Case**: Best for users who need the Office suite for productivity but already have an email solution.  
    *(Formerly Office 365 Business)*

- [Google Workspace](https://www.dot.ph/google-workspace/): A value-added service (VAS) by dotPH for individuals and organizations using a .PH domain - whether based in the Philippines or serving the Philippine market. Google Workspace provides professional-grade productivity and collaboration tools including Gmail, Google Drive, Docs, Sheets, and Meet - all branded under your own domain.

  - *Business Starter*: USD 92.40/user/year - Ideal for freelancers, solopreneurs, or small teams starting to build their online presence. Includes 30GB storage per user, business email (yourname@yourdomain.ph), Google Meet (100 participants), and access to Docs, Sheets, and Slides. Now also includes **Gemini AI assistant in Gmail**, **Chat with AI in the Gemini app**, and **Google Vids AI-powered video creator and editor**.  
    **Use Case**: Perfect for small businesses that want reliable branded email and basic cloud productivity without needing IT staff.

  - *Business Standard*: USD 184.80/user/year - Designed for growing teams or SMEs that need more collaboration power. Includes 2TB storage per user, advanced Meet features (150 participants, recording, and noise cancellation), file sharing controls, and enhanced admin tools. Now also includes **custom layouts and mail merge in Gmail**, **Gemini AI assistant in Gmail, Docs, Meet, and more**, **Chat with AI in the Gemini app (expanded features)**, **appointment booking pages**, **eSignature with Docs and PDFs**, and the **Google Workspace Migrate tool**.  
    **Use Case**: Best for remote or hybrid teams who need to share and work on files in real time with more storage, collaboration features, and security.

---

### VPS / Virtual Private Server Hosting

- [VPS Hosting](https://www.dot.ph/vps/): A value-added service (VAS) by dotPH for users who require more power, flexibility, and control than shared hosting. Designed for .PH domain owners running high-traffic sites, custom apps, or enterprise workloads that demand dedicated resources.

  - *MiddleWeight*: USD 175.00/month  
    2GB RAM, 200GB RAID Disk Space  
    **Use Case**: Suitable for hosting small business apps, databases, or multiple lightweight websites with custom configurations.

  - *CruiserWeight*: USD 325.00/month  
    4GB RAM, 500GB RAID Disk Space  
    **Use Case**: Ideal for growing businesses, staging environments, or medium-traffic eCommerce stores.

  - *HeavyWeight*: USD 650.00/month  
    8GB RAM, 1TB RAID Disk Space  
    **Use Case**: Best for large, busy websites or important business systems that need to run smoothly all the time.

---

### Domain Services

- [Domain Swap Service](https://www.dot.ph/domain-swap/): Swap your existing .PH domain for a new one - free every 2 weeks. Available for both standard and social media domains.
- [Reseller & Partner Program](https://partner.dot.ph/): Includes API/EPP access, partner portal, and wholesale pricing.
- [Marketplace - Domain Trading & Listings](https://www.dot.ph/marketplace/): Buy and sell .PH domains.
